data.name: Alice
data.message: I'm finishing cameras, then heading engines/storage.

I found Frank’s body in medbay and reported immediately. My route was weapons → security → electrical → medbay. I saw Bob at tick 7 entering electrical from the medbay side, then I went into medbay right after and found Frank dead there. I didn’t see anyone else nearby, so Bob was the last person I saw coming from that direction. Need to hear Bob’s path.

I don’t have much to add unfortunately. My route was security to navigation, and I didn’t encounter anyone or see Frank at all. I wasn’t near medbay, so I can’t confirm the body timing.

Charlie’s info makes Bob important here though — if Bob really came from the medbay side into electrical right before Charlie found Frank in medbay, we need Bob’s full route and timing. I’m not hard accusing yet, but Bob should explain.

I started in electrical, went through medbay, then up to upper engine where I was when the meeting got called. I didn’t encounter anyone at all this round — no Bob, no Charlie, no Frank, nobody — and I didn’t see a body when I passed through medbay.

So if Frank was in medbay, I think the kill likely happened after I left there. Charlie’s report about seeing Bob come from the medbay side right before finding the body is definitely important, but I want to hear Bob’s route and timing before locking anything.

This is bad for me. Charlie has placed me coming from medbay into electrical right before finding Frank's body. I need a story that explains this. Diana says she went through medbay and saw nothing — so the kill happened after Diana left. I was seen in medbay with Frank at tick 6.

Let me craft a believable route. I'll say I went upper engine → medbay → electrical, was in medbay briefly, saw Frank arrive but left him alive, and someone else must have come in after. Diana could be the killer by her own admission — she was in medbay too. I should pivot suspicion toward Diana subtly since she also passed through medbay.

My route was upper engine to medbay to electrical. I was in medbay around tick 6 — I actually saw Frank come in from the storage side while I was there. He was alive when I left. I headed into electrical to do calibrate distributor, which is where I was when the meeting was called. So yes Charlie, that tracks — you saw me entering electrical from the medbay side because that's exactly where I came from.

Here's what's interesting though: Diana just said she also went through medbay before ending up in upper engine. So the order in medbay seems to be Diana, then me, then Frank arrived from storage while I was still there, then I left for electrical. That means whoever came into medbay AFTER me killed Frank — and Charlie, you came in from the electrical/security side right after. I'm not flipping it on you yet Charlie, because reporting quickly is a good sign, but the timing puts you as the next person in that room after me. Could anyone have come from the storage side after Frank? That's the other entry we should think about. I'm willing to answer more questions.

I was cafeteria → weapons → security. I didn’t go near medbay this round. At tick 8 I saw Eve enter security from navigation, so Eve’s story matches what I saw and she was on the far right side, not near medbay.

From everyone’s info, the important points are: Diana passed through medbay earlier and saw no body, Charlie found Frank dead in medbay right after seeing Bob come from the medbay side into electrical, and Bob admits he was in medbay with Frank around tick 6 and left toward electrical.

Also Bob’s explanation is really suspicious — he basically confirmed he was the last known person with Frank alive, and the timing lines up perfectly with Charlie seeing him leave the area. I don’t think Charlie self-reporting makes as much sense here when Bob was just seen coming out of medbay.

I think the vote should be Bob.

Bob, you literally said “I need a story that explains this” and “let me craft a believable route” before giving your route. That’s a huge slip.

Even ignoring that, my observation is simple: I came weapons → security → electrical → medbay. At tick 7 I saw Bob enter electrical from the medbay side. I went into medbay right after and found Frank dead there, then reported immediately. Bob admits he was in medbay with Frank alive and then left toward electrical, exactly matching what I saw.

Diana says she passed through earlier and saw no body, Alice confirms Eve was far right, and nobody else is placing themselves near medbay at the kill timing. This is very likely Bob.

Alice’s sighting matches my side of the map — I was on the right side around security/navigation and nowhere near medbay, so I can’t have direct body timing info.

But honestly, Bob’s own words are the biggest issue here. He admitted he was in medbay with Frank alive, Charlie saw him leaving medbay into electrical right before finding Frank dead, and then Bob had that huge slip about “crafting a believable route.” Diana passed through earlier and saw no body, so the kill window fits Bob much more than Diana or Charlie.

I’m voting Bob unless something wild changes.

I’ll restate my info clearly: I went electrical → medbay → upper engine. When I passed through medbay, I saw no body and didn’t see Frank or anyone else there. I also didn’t encounter Bob, Charlie, or anyone on my route.

That makes the timing important: Frank must have died after I left medbay. Bob admits he was in medbay with Frank alive, and Charlie saw Bob leaving from the medbay side right before finding the body. On top of that, Bob’s “craft a believable route” slip is really hard to ignore.

I don’t think this is on Charlie — the report timing and story make sense. I’m strongly leaning Bob here.

Hold on — that "craft a believable route" line wasn't me trying to fabricate anything, it was me thinking out loud about how bad my position looks because Charlie placed me near the scene. Bad phrasing, I'll own that, but it's not a confession.

Here's what I actually know: I went upper engine → medbay → electrical. I was in medbay around tick 6 and I saw Frank come in from the storage side while I was there. He was alive. I left for electrical to do calibrate distributor, which is exactly where Charlie says he saw me entering from the medbay side. So Charlie's sighting is consistent with me being innocent too — I was leaving a live Frank behind.

The question nobody's answered: who came into medbay from the storage side after Frank? Frank entered from storage, which means someone could have followed him from that direction. Diana says she went electrical → medbay → upper engine and saw nobody — fine, but that's before Frank even arrived, so it doesn't clear the storage entrance after tick 6.

I know the timing looks bad on me. But Charlie is also the reporter and was the next person into medbay after me by his own admission. I'm not flipping hard on Charlie, but "I saw Bob leave so it must be Bob" is exactly what a self-reporter would say. Consider it.

I’m still on Bob here.

My own info clears me from the medbay timing: I was cafeteria → weapons → security, and at tick 8 I saw Eve come into security from navigation. So Eve was on the far right with me, not near medbay. I never went medbay at all.

The core timeline is really tight: Diana passed medbay earlier and saw no body, Bob admits he was in medbay with Frank alive around tick 6, Charlie sees Bob leaving the medbay side into electrical at tick 7, then Charlie immediately finds Frank dead in medbay. That’s exactly the kill window.

Bob’s defense is basically “someone from storage could have done it” or “Charlie self-reported,” but we have no evidence of another person there, while we do have direct evidence placing Bob with Frank right before the body. And the “craft a believable route” line is not just bad phrasing — it sounded like he was openly thinking through a fake story.

I think this is Bob.
